item.title: Wiring Pact Into CI/CD: The Full Contract Testing Pipeline
item.description: Pulling consumer tests, contract publishing, provider verification, and can-i-deploy into one end to end CI/CD pipeline for both services.

item.title: Versioning Contracts and Catching Breaking Changes in Pact
item.description: How Pact tracks contract versions over time, tagging by branch and environment, and what a genuinely breaking change looks like in the broker.

item.title: Gating Releases with Pact's can-i-deploy
item.description: Using Pact's can-i-deploy CLI check as an automated release gate, so a service cannot deploy against a contract nobody has verified.

item.title: Publishing and Sharing Contracts with a Pact Broker
item.description: Standing up a Pact Broker, publishing consumer contracts to it automatically, and pulling them into provider verification tests.

item.title: Verifying Pact Contracts on the Provider Side
item.description: Replaying a Pact contract against the real provider service, setting up provider states, and reading a verification failure.

item.title: Writing Your First Pact Consumer Test
item.description: Turning a Pact contract definition into a real test method, calling actual client code against the mock server, and generating a contract file.

item.title: Setting Up Pact for a Spring Boot Consumer
item.description: Adding Pact JVM to a Spring Boot project, the project layout it expects, and the first empty consumer test skeleton.

item.title: Consumer-Driven Contract Testing Explained
item.description: What consumer-driven contract testing actually solves, and why it fits microservices better than end-to-end tests or shared integration environments.
